It reinforces the idea that every individual is a unique manifestation of the divine.

historical_references.reference: The Kayan or Kaiyans were an ancient people of the Indian subcontinent, mentioned in the Rigveda, a sacred text of Hinduism, which dates back to around 1500-1000 BCE. They are believed to be the early inhabitants of the areas now known as Punjab and Sindh.
